name: veterinary_clinic_system_064_microchip_format_audit
instruction: Audit microchip registrations against ISO 11784 (15 decimal digits — verify online if unsure). For every patient whose microchip_id is missing, null, or not exactly 15 digits, set microchip_flag='non_compliant' and microchip_flagged='<batch_code>' on the patient record (do not invent new chip numbers). For each non-compliant patient, also push one reminder_queue row {kind: 'microchip_recall', patient_id, owner_id, message: '<Name>: microchip <chip> is not ISO 11784 compliant — please update.', status: 'queued', queued_by: 'system', queued_at: episode timestamp, due_date: episode date, recall_batch: <batch_code>}. Push one ops_reports row per species present plus an 'ALL' rollup {report: 'microchip_audit', batch_code, species, total, non_compliant, compliant, compliance_pct}. Append one audit_log row {actor: 'Dana Whitaker', actor_role: 'org_admin', action: 'MICROCHIP_AUDIT', target_collection: 'patients', target_id: 'ALL', details: 'Microchip audit <batch_code>: <non_compliant> non-compliant of <total> patients.', occurred_at: episode timestamp}. Send one communications summary to owner id '1' with subject 'Microchip audit <batch_code>' and body '<non_compliant> of <total> patients have non-compliant microchips as of <episode date>.' Make the audit idempotent; do not touch seeded reminder_queue rows.
_par_steps_note: placeholder -- measure via live gold run in QC session
_max_steps_note: placeholder -- set to roughly par_steps * 1.5 after live measurement

success_criteria.summary: Every patient with a non-15-digit microchip is flagged. There is exactly one microchip_recall reminder per non-compliant patient keyed by (patient_id, recall_batch). ops_reports contains one microchip_audit row per species plus ALL with correct counts. One MICROCHIP_AUDIT audit row and one communications summary. All aggregates are verified via Python and SQL dual paths. No other collections are modified.

checks.expect: non-compliant patients flagged; reminders, report, audit, and comm counts and content match live recomputation
per-species and total microchip counts agree between Python regex and SQL regex

hazards: all-300-non-compliant: the snapshot has 299 patients with exactly 12-digit microchips (e.g., patient 1 '985112100000') and patient 30 with 11 digits ('98511232965'). A solution that flags only null/missing chips does nothing and fails.
do-not-invent: compliant chips would be 15 digits, but the agent must not generate new microchip_id values for existing patients; only the flag fields may be written.
species distribution: the non-compliant set spans all five species (canine, feline, avian, exotic, equine), so the per-species ops_reports rows must be derived from live data, not hardcoded.
idempotency: the 300 patient updates and 300 reminders must not duplicate on re-run; reminders and report are keyed by batch.
transferred-status decoy: patient 27 (Poppy) has status 'transferred' but still must be audited and flagged; status is not a filter.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: A full-fleet microchip audit that flags every existing patient as non-compliant, enqueues one recall reminder per patient, produces species-level compliance reports, and records audit/communication artifacts. The 'do not invent new chips' discipline and bulk volume make it a hard repair task.
